title: AI Alignment and Fiduciary Obligation
abstract: arXiv:2608.02660v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Advanced AI assistants engage users in extended interactions across a widening range of roles, including advice, decision support, collaboration, learning, emotional support, and companionship among others. Current alignment efforts consider what alignment criteria should govern these relationships, drawing on moral traditions developed for human relationships such as bioethics, virtue ethics, care ethics, and relationship science. This paper considers AI alignment criteria in the user-AI-developer triad, since every user-AI interaction is mediated by a developer who exercises discretionary control over a system's behaviour, memory, and engagement parameters. Drawing on business ethics and legal scholarship, I argue that fiduciary theory applies to extended AI assistant deployment. On this basis, the four canonical fiduciary duties of loyalty, care, good faith, and candour can generate alignment criteria for the developer-user

translated_title: 人工智能对齐与受托责任
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.02660v2 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：高级人工智能助手在与用户进行扩展互动中，涉及越来越广泛的角色，包括建议、决策支持、协作、学习、情感支持和陪伴等。当前的对齐工作考虑应有哪些对齐标准来管理这些关系，借鉴了为人类关系发展的道德传统，如生物伦理学、美德伦理学、关怀伦理学和关系科学。本文考虑了用户-人工智能-开发者三元组中的对齐标准，因为每次用户与人工智能的互动都由开发者调解，开发者对系统的行为、记忆和参与参数行使自由裁量控制。借鉴商业伦理和法律学术，我认为受托责任理论适用于扩展的人工智能助手部署。在此基础上，忠诚、谨慎、善意和坦诚这四项经典受托责任义务可以为开发者-用户关系生成对齐标准。
tldr: 本文提出将受托责任理论应用于人工智能助手部署，以忠诚、谨慎、善意和坦诚四项义务为开发者-用户互动制定对齐标准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes applying fiduciary theory to AI assistant deployment, deriving alignment criteria for developer-user interactions from the four canonical duties of loyalty, care, good faith, and candour.
